sentences: You're on the twentieth floor when the elevator cable suddenly snaps.
As the elevator drops down the shaft, you feel your stomach jump into your throat.
You pull out your phone and text your mom goodbye,
and right before you hit the ground, you bend your knees to jump.
But after just a few feet, the elevator stops on its own,
and you jump for nothing and smack your head on the ceiling.
That's because every elevator has a brake underneath that clamps onto the rails if it goes too fast, and that brake would always stop you.
